lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sit. *slides folder* I brought my lawyer.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: One thousand won is infwation. We negotiate.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Inflation? Where'd you even learn that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.tts: 엄마가 아빠 보면서 맨날 한 말이여.
lines.en: Mommy says it. Looking at you. Evewy day.

lines.speaker: B
lines.tts: 오천. 안 그럼 뽀뽀 서비스 중단이여.
lines.en: Five thousand. Or kissy service shuts down.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Bizniss is cold, Daddy. Ice cold.

lines.speaker: B
lines.tts: 곰돌이 변호사님. 수임료 꿀 한 숟갈.
lines.en: Mister Teddy Bear, Esquire. Retainer: one spoon of honey.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: *slides 5,000* ...You're the scariest person in this house.

description_en: A 4-year-old renegotiates her allowance citing inflation, holds kisses hostage, and consults her lawyer (a teddy bear).
